name: Motorcycle
description: A vehicle on no more than three wheels with a fixed handlebar, a seat at least 650 mm high, wheel rims of at least 250 mm, a wheelbase of at least 1,016 mm and a top speed over 50 km/h; an electric two-wheeler that can exceed 50 km/h, such as an e-moto or a street-plated electric dirt bike, is one.

restrictions.rule: No more than three wheels, a handlebar fixed to one wheel's axle, a seat at least 650 mm high unladen, wheel rims at least 250 mm and a wheelbase at least 1,016 mm
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Can go faster than 50 km/h, with no limit on motor power; not a moped or power-assisted bicycle
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: One faster than 50 km/h but under these dimensions is neither a motorcycle nor a moped
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a Class 6 motorcycle licence
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting the regulations' standards, unless it has a cab enclosing them
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 187(1) and (2)

restrictions.rule: A passenger rides only on a seat designed for one, on a motorcycle built to carry more than one person
restrictions.citation: The Highway Traffic Act, C.C.S.M. c. H60, s. 184(3)

restrictions.rule: Registered and plated, with the Manitoba Public Insurance premium paid at registration
restrictions.citation: The Drivers and Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. D104, ss. 34, 38(2) and 40(6)

restrictions.rule: One ridden anywhere but a highway is an off-road vehicle
restrictions.citation: The Off-Road Vehicles Act, C.C.S.M. c. O31, s. 1(1)
